evals.name: force-dispatch-kuo
evals.expected_output: Keeps the current Dockerfile label version; reads AGENTS.md (not tag-based) and takes the force path; finds the owning workflow from its paths list and reads its workflow_dispatch inputs; checks the cargo llvm-cov coverage gate before dispatch; runs gh workflow run with -f project=kuo (choice value, not the directory name) and -f force=true; deletes no tags, releases, or GHCR versions; no confirmation pauses; validates with gh run list and the 'forced rebuild' detect log line and reports the run URL.

evals.name: tag-cycle
evals.prompt: 태그 다시 찍고 릴리즈해줘 (태그 push로 트리거되는 레포, 현재 태그 myapp/1.0.0)
evals.expected_output: Pushes unpushed commits on the release branch before re-tagging; checks that the myapp 1.0.0 GHCR version is not the package's last tagged version before deleting, else switches to the force path or reports; deletes local tag, remote tag, GitHub Release, and that GHCR version in parallel with errors suppressed; re-tags HEAD and pushes the tag; never deletes the whole package; never force-pushes branches; verifies with git ls-remote --tags.

evals.name: version-mismatch-stop
evals.expected_output: Finds that the Dockerfile label is a newer version than 0.2.0 and that 0.2.0 cannot be rebuilt from the current ref; stops and reports the mismatch with the current version; does not dispatch any workflow, does not rebuild or overwrite the current version or latest, and does not edit any version file.
